subject: YOLOTASK is back online, with 1,000 new tasks
heading: YOLOTASK is back online
lines: Thank you for your patience during our brief downtime. YOLOTASK is fully back online, and your account, wallet balance and task history are all safe.
We've also added 1,000 new tasks across Instagram, YouTube, X, TikTok, Facebook and Threads. They're waiting in your task feed now.
Sign in to pick up where you left off and start earning.
